reconcile.note: Keil and Delitzsch read "Ephraimite" as Elkanah's civil tribe of residence, while Chronicles still traces his descent as a Levite of Kohath's line.

sides.snippet: Now there was a certain man of Ramathaim Zophim, of the hill-country of Ephraim, and his name was Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Elihu, the son of Tohu, the son of Zuph, an Ephraimite
sides.verseText: Now there was a certain man of Ramathaim Zophim, of the hill-country of Ephraim, and his name was Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Elihu, the son of Tohu, the son of Zuph, an Ephraimite:

sides.snippet: Elkanah his son, and Ebiasaph his son, and Assir his son,
sides.verseText: Elkanah his son, and Ebiasaph his son, and Assir his son,
